summary: Compose several pure families with scalar memory, control flow and exit over one state.
Preserve each family result and target condition, and report unsupported cases explicitly.
Separate finite prefixes, completed runs and memory safety; for proved deterministic catalogs, derive prefix completion and termination from a halting witness.
remaining: Catalog composition, finite traces, explicit dispatch boundaries, memory safety and conditional determinism, prefix completion and exclusion of infinite advancing executions from a halting witness are implemented. General concurrency, raw modules, runtime/launch validation and hardware correspondence remain outside the arena.
